theory: Qualify the introductory $10^k$ rule to readings of the form $\log_{10}Q$: decibels require division by $10$, pH reverses direction, and star magnitudes require the negative multiplier. The claim that adding logarithmic readings is never correct is false: logarithms can be added to represent products, although readings cannot simply be added to combine physical quantities. Star magnitudes are mentioned in the syllabus but their formula and method are absent from the supplied teaching.
